prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production game animation sprite sheet, transparent PNG, six frames in an EXACT uniform 3-column by 2-row grid on a landscape 1536 by 1024 canvas. Each cell exactly 512 by 512. No grid lines, no labels.
Input image: the supplied cozy chibi Asal is the sole identity and art reference. Preserve her EXACT design: long highlighted wavy brown hair, large gray-green eyes, round blushing face, tiny silver earrings and necklace, oversized sage-teal cardigan with brown buttons, ivory shirt and notebook, short navy trouser legs, cream shoes. Same warm outlined 2D illustration style.
Task: Draw SIX sequential frames of this SAME character greeting with a little waving hand and blinking. Full character in every cell, ALL six figures must have identical scale and registration: vertical head-to-shoe bounds approximately y=24 to y=488 within each 512px cell; stable body center x=256 and stable shoes baseline y=488. The head, torso, notebook, clothing, hair, feet and facial features must remain stationary in the SAME position from frame to frame. ONLY the raised waving forearm/hand and eyelids change. Avoid any breathing, tilting body, drifting, zoom, or redesign between cells.
Frame order, read left to right then next row: frame 1 (top left): eyes fully open, friendly smile, raised hand at neutral greeting angle. Frame 2 (top middle): eyes open, hand tilted gently outward 12 degrees at wrist. Frame 3 (top right): eyes gently closed in two cute curved smiling eyelids (a natural blink), hand tilted gently inward 12 degrees. Frame 4 (bottom left): eyes fully reopened, hand tilted outward 12 degrees. Frame 5 (bottom middle): eyes fully open, hand tilted gently inward 8 degrees. Frame 6 (bottom right): eyes fully open, hand returned to neutral, EXACT same pose as frame 1 to end smoothly.
Keep the other hand holding the cream notebook perfectly still. Every head and foot fully visible with cell margins. Genuinely transparent background across entire sheet and between figures, no ground or background fill. No text, no decorative extras, no borders or watermarks. Crisp readable sprites, consistent character geometry is the highest priority.
refinementPrompt: Edit this exact six-frame sprite sheet. Keep the 1536x1024 layout, 3 columns and 2 rows of 512x512 cells, and every character's size and position unchanged. Two precise corrections: (1) Remove ALL background haze, brown glow and cast shadows from around the six characters, producing perfectly clean fully transparent negative space right up to the character silhouettes. No halo whatsoever. (2) Make the hand wave clearly visible between frames, with only the waving forearm moving: in the TOP MIDDLE and BOTTOM LEFT cells extend the raised forearm outward to the viewer's LEFT, open palm rotated outward around 25 degrees; in the TOP RIGHT and BOTTOM MIDDLE cells tilt that same raised open palm inward near her cheek by 15 degrees. Keep top left and bottom right as neutral waving pose. The TOP RIGHT frame must retain both eyes gently CLOSED with curved smiling eyelids; every other frame retains the same open gray-green eyes. Preserve character identity, exact cozy cardigan outfit, highlighted hair, notebook, face, head, torso and feet, identical registration and proportions in all six cells. No movement of the whole body, no extra decorations, no text.
playback: One 1.6 second greeting on opening the helper; portrait button replays it. Reduced motion shows neutral frame.
